summary: Verified bug fix: admin-role users can now access /jkhive/bi. Backend BI endpoints accept admin tokens (was 403). /api/admin/ai-settings still correctly super_admin-only and the BI page degrades gracefully when the AI key panel returns 403. Super_admin regression passes.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/Routes.jsx still keeps `SuperAdminOnly` component (unused after this fix). Safe to delete for cleanliness.
/app/frontend/src/pages/admin-bi/index.jsx header subtitle still says 'super admin only' / 'super admin' (lines 586) although the page is now admin-accessible. Cosmetic but misleading copy.
Stray `Routes;` expression statement at /app/frontend/src/Routes.jsx line 423 — no-op but should be removed (the equivalent of the earlier `nBI;` artefact).
No public POST /api/admin/users endpoint exists, so admin role users can only be seeded via DB. Consider exposing one (super_admin only) for ops convenience.

seed_data_creation: Inserted role=admin user `test_admin_bi@jollys.com` into users collection via pymongo (no public create-user endpoint exists). Documented above so future runs can re-use.
